title: 考研英语二2012年真题及答案解析（整卷）

sentences.text: This rule is meant to address the difficulty that students from impoverished or chaotic homes might have in completing their homework.
sentences.translation: 这项规定旨在解决来自贫困或混乱家庭的学生在完成家庭作业方面可能遇到的困难。但该政策不明确且自相矛盾。当然,不应布置学生无法独立完成或需要昂贵设备才能完成的家庭作业。但如果学区实质上是对那些因家庭生活复杂而不做家庭作业的学生网开一面,那就危险地接近于暗示需要为贫困儿童降低标准。

sentences.text: But the policy is unclear and contradictory.
Certainly, no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment.

But if the district is essentially giving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children.
At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework.
sentences.translation: 与此同时,该政策没有解决任何关于家庭作业的真正棘手问题。如果学区认为家庭作业对学生的学业成就不重要,就应该采取措施减少或取消作业,而不是让它们几乎不计分。相反,如果家庭作业很重要,它就应该占成绩的很大一部分。同时,该政策没有采取任何措施来确保学生收到的家庭作业是有意义的或适合他们的年龄和科目的,也没有确保教师布置的作业不超过他们愿意批改和纠正的数量。

sentences.text: If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students' academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing.
Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade.

Meanwhile, this policy does nothing to ensure that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject, or that teachers are not assigning more than they are willing to review and correct.
The homework rules should be put on hold while the school board, which is responsible for setting educational policy, looks into the matter and conducts public hearings.
sentences.translation: 家庭作业规定应该暂停执行,由负责制定教育政策的学校董事会调查此事并举行公开听证会。洛杉矶联合学区现在纠正家庭作业政策还为时不晚。

sentences.text: It is not too late for L.A. Unified to do homework right.
Pretty in pink: adult women do not remember being so obsessed with the colour, yet it is pervasive in our young girls' lives.
sentences.translation: 粉红色真美：成年女性并不记得自己曾如此痴迷于这种颜色，然而它却充斥在我们年幼女孩的生活中。粉红色本身并非坏事，但它只是彩虹中极小的一部分，尽管它可能在某种程度上赞颂女孩特质，但它也反复而坚定地将女孩的身份与外表融合在一起。然后它呈现出这种联系，甚至在两岁大的孩子中间，将女孩们之间的这种联系不仅视为纯真的表现，而且视为纯真本身的证据。环顾四周，我对女孩生活和兴趣方面想象力的极度匮乏感到绝望。

sentences.text: It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls' identity to appearance.
Then it presents that connection, even among two-year-olds, between girls as not only innocent but as evidence of innocence.
Looking around, I despaired at the singular lack of imagination about girls' lives and interests.
Girls' attraction to pink may seem unavoidable, somehow encoded in their DNA, but according to Jo Paoletti, an associate professor of American Studies, it is not.
sentences.translation: 懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/kaoyan/sections/2012-english-two/section2-part-a-2/?f=p · 在线使⽤效果更好children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherentlyattractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.女孩对粉红色的喜爱似乎不可避免，仿佛编码在她们的DNA中，但根据美国研究副教授Jo Paoletti的说法，事实并非如此。直到20世纪初，儿童才开始按颜色区分：在家用洗衣机出现之前的时代，出于实际考虑，所有婴儿都穿白色衣服,因为清洗衣物的唯一方法是煮沸它们。而且，男孩和女孩都穿被认为是中性的连衣裙。当育儿室颜色被引入时，粉红色实际上被认为是更具男性气质的颜色，是红色的柔和版本，与力量相关联。蓝色则因其让人联想到圣母玛利亚、坚定和忠诚，象征着女性气质。直到20世纪80年代中期，当放大年龄和性别差异成为儿童市场营销的主导策略时，粉红色才真正确立了自己的地位，它开始似乎天然地吸引女孩，成为定义她们作为女性的一部分，至少在最初几年的关键时期是如此。

sentences.text: Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century: in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter, since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them.
What's more, both boys and girls wore what were thought of as gender-neutral dresses.
When nursery colours were introduced, pink was actually considered the more masculine colour, a pastel version of red, which was associated with strength.
Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity.
It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant
I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development.
sentences.translation: 我没有意识到市场营销趋势如此深刻地影响了我们对儿童天性的认知，包括我们关于他们心理发展的核心信念。以学步儿童为例。我原以为这个阶段是专家们经过多年研究儿童行为后提出的：错了。事实证明,根据儿童消费主义历史学家Daniel Cook的说法，它是在20世纪30年代作为服装制造商的营销手段而流行起来的。

sentences.text: Take the toddler.
I assumed that phase was something experts developed after years of research into children's behaviour: wrong.
Turns out, according to Daniel Cook, a historian of childhood consumerism, it was popularised as a marketing trick by clothing manufacturers in the 1930s.
But as companies continue their attempts at personalised medicine, the courts will remain rather busy.
sentences.translation: 懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/kaoyan/sections/2012-english-two/section2-part-a-3/?f=p · 在线使⽤效果更好October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNAmolecule "is no less a product of nature…than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cottonseeds."但随着各公司继续尝试个性化医疗,法院将依然相当繁忙。Myriad案件本身很可能尚未结束。批评者提出了反对基因专利的三个主要论点:基因是自然产物,因此不可授予专利;基因专利抑制创新而非奖励创新;专利的垄断限制了人们获得诸如Myriad的基因检测的机会。越来越多的人似乎表示赞同。去年,一个联邦工作组敦促改革与基因检测相关的专利。10月,司法部在Myriad案件中提交了一份简报,论证称分离的DNA分子"与从棉籽中分离出来的棉纤维一样,都是自然产物"。

sentences.text: The Myriad case itself is probably not over.

Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's.
A growing number seem to agree.
Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.

Despite the appeals court's decision, big questions remain unanswered.
sentences.translation: 尽管上诉法院作出了裁决,重大问题仍未得到解答。例如,对整个基因组进行测序是否侵犯了其中单个基因的专利尚不清楚。该案件可能最终会上诉至最高法院。

sentences.text: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
The case may yet reach the Supreme Court.
Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue, brought by the Mayo Clinic, which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term.
sentences.translation: 它们的成功可能取决于与此问题相关的一起诉讼,该诉讼由Mayo Clinic提起,最高法院将在下一任期审理此案。BIO最近举办了一次会议,其中包括指导律师应对专利格局变化的研讨会。每场会议都座无虚席。

sentences.text: The BIO recently held a convention which included sessions to coach lawyers on the shifting landscape for patents.
Each meeting was packed.
The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably beginning.
sentences.translation: 大衰退或许已经结束，但这个高失业率的时代可能才刚刚开始。在它结束之前，它很可能会改变一代年轻人的人生轨迹和性格特征。而且最终，它很可能在未来数年重塑我们的政治、我们的文化以及我们社会的特征。

sentences.text: Before it ends, it will likely change the life course and character of a generation of young adults.
And ultimately, it is likely to reshape our politics, our culture, and the character of our society for years.
No one tries harder than the jobless to find silver linings in this national economic disaster.
sentences.translation: 没有人比失业者更努力地试图在这场全国性经济灾难中寻找一线希望。许多人说，失业虽然极其痛苦，但在某些方面改善了他们：他们变得不那么物质主义，在财务上更加审慎；他们更能意识到他人的挣扎。在有限的方面，也许这场衰退会让社会变得更好。至少，它把我们从轻松致富和更大房子的全民狂热梦想中唤醒，并给一个鲁莽的个人消费时代画上了必要的句号。

sentences.text: Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others.
In limited respects, perhaps the recession will leave society better off.
At the very least, it has awoken us from our national fever dream of easy riches and bigger houses, and put a necessary end to an era of reckless personal spending.
But for the most part, these benefits seem thin, uncertain, and far off.
sentences.translation: 懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/kaoyan/sections/2012-english-two/section2-part-a-4/?f=p · 在线使⽤效果更好more mean-spirited and less inclusive, and have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights andfreedoms. Anti-immigrant sentiment typically increases, as does conflict between races and classes.但在大多数情况下，这些好处似乎微薄、不确定且遥远。在《经济增长的道德后果》一书中，经济史学家Benjamin Friedman认为，无论在美国国内还是国外，漫长的经济停滞或衰退期几乎总是让社会变得更加刻薄、包容性更差，并且通常会阻止或逆转权利和自由的进步。反移民情绪通常会增加，种族和阶级之间的冲突也会增加。

sentences.text: In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth, the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues that both inside and outside the U.S., lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have almost always left society
In the Internet age, it is particularly easy to see the resentment that has always been hidden within American society.
sentences.translation: 在互联网时代，特别容易看到一直隐藏在美国社会内部的怨恨。更困难的是，在当下准确辨别这些艰难时期如何影响社会性格。在许多方面，美国进入这次衰退时比其历史上任何时期都更具社会包容性，而此后关于社会冲突的各种全国性民调显示了好坏参半的结果。我们必须等待并观察这些艰难时期将如何重塑我们的社会结构。但它们肯定会重塑社会结构，而且持续时间越长，影响就越大。

sentences.text: More difficult, in the moment, is discerning precisely how these lean times are affecting society's character.
In many respects, the U.S. was more socially tolerant entering this recession than at any time in its history, and a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results.
We will have to wait and see exactly how these hard times will reshape our social fabric.
But they certainly will reshape it, and all the more so the longer they extend.
